text: The ATNF catalogue performs no name resolution, so 'Crab' would match nothing. The Crab pulsar is J0534+2200 (B0531+21); querying with the designation.

ATNF has J0534+2200 (B0531+21), the Crab pulsar: P0 = 0.0333924 s, DM = 56.77 pc/cm3, S1400 = 14.0 mJy. I queried by designation rather than by name because ATNF does no name resolution -- 'Crab' returns an empty result rather than an error, which would have read as the pulsar not being catalogued.
